summary: Iter14 — internal auction mirror page verified end-to-end. Backend 3/3 GREEN: GET /api/auto/auctions/calendar?days_ahead=21 returns events that all carry a 12-char hex event_id; GET /api/auto/auctions/events/<event_id> returns {event, vehicles} with translate_event_doc-applied Russian fields (title/branch/city Cyrillic, *_en originals preserved); GET /api/auto/auctions/events/this-id-does-not-exist returns 404 with detail 'Аукцион не найден.'. Frontend GREEN: /auto/auctions now exposes 20+ data-testid=auction-link-<event_id> elements; every href starts with /auto/auctions/event/, target≠_blank, 0 external Turners/Manheim hrefs in the table. Clicking the first link keeps the visitor on the preview host and renders /auto/auctions/event/f5f76e0c679a with all required testids (auction-event, auction-title, auction-when, auction-lots, auction-vehicles-count showing «Лоты ещё не появились», auction-vehicles-empty visible with a /auto/my/searches «Создать подписку» link). Garbage id → auction-event-error fallback + «К календарю» link back to /auto/auctions. Homepage /auto auction-card-0-link href = /auto/auctions/event/f5f76e0c679a (internal), no target=_blank. The Turners/Manheim outbound redirect bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: services/auto_auctions_service.py — event_with_vehicles falls back to a full-collection scan when looking up legacy docs without event_id. For now the calendar collection is small (~110 docs) but if it grows, indexing or a one-time migration that sets event_id on every doc would avoid the O(N) scan on each 404-recovery path.

AutoAuctionEvent.jsx — mirror page only matches vehicles when source matches AND auction_ends_at falls within a ±36h window. Most Turners/Manheim imports do not currently populate auction_ends_at, so the «Найдено: N» badge will show «Лоты ещё не появились» for virtually every event in production. This is acceptable per spec (empty list is allowed) but worth surfacing as a roadmap item — wiring auction_ends_at into the importers would unlock the actual mirror value.

AutoAuctionsCalendar.jsx line 211 — encodeURIComponent(e.event_id || e.key) means legacy events without event_id fall back to encoding the raw `turners:https://...` key into the URL, which then has to be percent-decoded and SHA1-recomputed by the backend. list_events already back-fills event_id on the fly, so in practice this branch never fires. Consider dropping the fallback so a misconfigured row throws a build-time TypeError instead of generating a 404.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (iter13): /auto/auctions «Открыть» CTA was an <a href={event.auction_url} target=_blank> linking directly to turners.co.nz / manheim.co.nz, kicking the visitor off the site. FIX (iter14 by main agent): (a) AuctionEvent.to_doc now embeds a stable event_id = sha1(key)[:12], with list_events back-filling it on the fly and ensure_indexes adding an index. (b) New GET /api/auto/auctions/events/{event_id} returns {event, vehicles} — event with Russian translations and any catalogue vehicles ending within ±36h of the auction. (c) AutoAuctionsCalendar.jsx swapped the external anchor for <Link to=/auto/auctions/event/...>. (d) New AutoAuctionEvent.jsx route at /auto/auctions/event/:eventId renders the mirror; only an «Источник» button (when vehicles list is empty) ever links out to Turners/Manheim. (e) AutoHome.jsx auction cards now point to /auto/auctions/event/<event_id>. Verified: clicking «Открыть» keeps user on auto-nz-bidding.preview.emergentagent.com 100% of the time.
